Tess (People Ops): Putting a short, copy-first kit here: self-review + manager checklist + a 3-item scoring shorthand for calibration. Keep it minimal so teams actually use it.
Mark (Eng Manager): love minimal. can you give a 2-sentence manager blurb I can paste in emails?
Tess (People Ops): email blurb: 'Please prepare a 1-paragraph self-review and 2 supporting links. We'll use a 10m midpoint to align on progress and one concrete unblock.'
Sanjay (Data Eng): give me the 1-paragraph self-review template devs can paste verbatim.
Tess (People Ops): 1-paragraph self-review (copy/paste):
"""
Role & scope: [one line].
Top outcomes this period: [1-3 bullets with links or metrics].
Key tradeoffs / lessons: [one line].
Blocker(s) I need help with: [one line].
Concrete growth ask (next period): [one sentence].
"""
Lena (Recruiter): any short manager checklist for calibration meetings?
Tess (People Ops): manager calibration checklist (pasteable):
- Bring: self-review + 2 evidentiary links (PRs, dashboards, customer notes).
- Ask: 1-line impact statement for each objective.
- Use: 3-item shorthand scoring: Progress / Ownership / Risk (Green/Amber/Red).
Mark (Eng Manager): nice. show sample scoring filled for one objective?
Tess (People Ops): sample (one objective):
Objective: Reduce inference cost 15%
- Progress: Amber (saved 8% to date, dashboard link)
- Ownership: Green (led cross-team rollout)
- Risk: Red (blocked by infra quota)
Mark (Eng Manager): ok to add a one-line note explaining each color?
Tess (People Ops): yes 1-line color key: Green = on track, measurable progress. Amber = some progress, needs support. Red = blocked or off-track.
Sanjay (Data Eng): can managers request peer input with one quick async prompt?
Tess (People Ops): peer prompt (one-liner): 'Two bullets: 1) one thing they did that helped your work; 2) one short improvement suggestion.' Keep it optional and 48h turnaround.
Lena (Recruiter): for calibration, should we attach role-level expectation doc?
Tess (People Ops): attach role expectations when available. If not, include a 1-line scope note in the self-review.
Mark (Eng Manager): any suggested phrasing for managers when delivering mid-cycle corrective feedback?
Tess (People Ops): manager corrective feedback script (short):
"I want to align on expectation X. Here's the evidence I see, here's the impact, and here's one concrete change we can try this cycle. How does that sound?"
CheckinBot: Tip: schedule midpoint nudges with `/checkin schedule --when mid-2w --team @team-name` or add to the cycle template. Docs: /docs/performance/checkins
Sanjay (Data Eng): can we version these so teams can adapt?
Tess (People Ops): version v1.2. If you adapt, post the version tag and a 1-line summary of changes here so we can keep the canonical doc tidy.
Mark (Eng Manager): we'll adapt for async-heavy teams (will post v1.2-async).
Tess (People Ops): thanks! small ask: if you localize examples (e.g., on-call vs non-on-call), note "format preference" in the review to help calibrators.
Lena (Recruiter): copying this into the new hires onboarding kit.
Tess (People Ops): great 16:partyparrot:
